title: Make Vercel the durable source of Convex Preview secrets

target.candidate_state: uncommitted working tree independently reviewed before publication

north_star: Reconcile approved branch-scoped Vercel Preview values into the exact Marketplace-managed Convex Preview on every dev deployment without persisting secrets in Workflow state.

evidence.hosted_root_cause: confirmed — Vercel and Convex held inconsistent lead proof secrets, causing INVALID_INTAKE_PROOF and fail-closed 503 responses
evidence.manual_recovery: pass — the Preview-only secret was rotated transactionally into Vercel Preview(dev) and cool-lynx-973
evidence.hosted_smoke: pass — root returned 200, protected operations returned 307, the first synthetic lead was created, and its repeat returned the same receipt as a duplicate
evidence.implementation: pass locally — Vercel creates the branch Preview, syncs five approved values over stdin to --preview-name, then redeploys Convex and seeds the organization
evidence.secret_handling: pass locally — values are validated, never placed in command arguments, never printed, and are sent only over child-process stdin
evidence.production_isolation: pass locally — sync refuses non-Preview execution and the Production build remains npm run build only
evidence.tests: pass — 34 files / 195 tests, including behavior and build-order coverage
evidence.static_checks: pass — lint, tsc --noEmit, skills, environment, assets, and git diff checks passed
evidence.dependency_audit: pass — npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities
evidence.independent_review: pass — evaluator found sound command ordering, stdin-only secret handling, fail-closed branch scoping, and Production isolation with no blocker

residual_risk: The merged dev build must demonstrate the automatic sync step and repeat the hosted lead smoke before stale branch configuration is removed.
